summary: A pack rerun that yields no post-ready shot for a platform archives the earlier manifest under a unique superseded name instead of leaving it post-ready or deleting it, and a completed prediction whose download failed is recorded in the library with its prediction ID, output URLs, and recovery command.
reason: Posting tools read manifest.json as the current pack, so a stale one could publish old assets, while deleting it lost the earlier pack. Library records are the only durable trace of a paid result once command output is gone.
validated_outcome: TestPackManifestSkipsShotsWithMissingDownloads keeps exactly one archived manifest; TestNoteDownloadFailureIsWarningNotError checks the stored prediction ID and URL.
